svg.aria-label: Left: one-sided power spectral density using 50 Hz sampling, a Hann window, and linear detrending. Right: sinusoidal amplitude gain calculated directly from filter coefficients, with 9 Hz marked. Gain describes the filter; spectral density describes the finite records.
